entry.title: Aladdin Tower

buildingCutout.basis: Retain original6m standard Mapzen grid, native paths/roads/water and all independent neighboring buildings. The broad named memorial parent and circular part are two representations of the same landmark; replace both generic shells. The model remains bounded to the tower and porch, leaving the rest of the named site as original ground rather than inventing a2m precinct slab. Small level footing sits just above the highest occupied rim, with buried sides below the lowest. No ground/water cutout or square flattening. The cropped ground photos and coarse DEM do not establish actual plaza/foundation engineering or a surveyed entrance azimuth.
